scheme_name: Award of Pre-Matric Scholarship to Other Economically Backward Class (OEBC) Students
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or have continuous residence for at least five years.
Applicant must be studying in standards 6 to 10 and must have secured promotion to the next higher class.
Eligibility category noted in source: Other Economically Backward Class
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly scholarship of ₹50 for standards 6‑8 and ₹75 for standards 9‑10, paid for ten months each academic year.
